stories.title: Baseline (as is)
stories.what_happened: Nothing has gone wrong yet. This is the plan for the coming year, before any disruption.
stories.what_the_plan_did: It serves 99.45% of demand at a landed cost of €23.37M, moving it in 2,762 truck trips. It clears every governance gate, so it could be released to the factory without anyone signing it off.

stories.title: The road into Venlo closes
stories.what_happened: The motorway into Venlo closes for two weeks, from day 7 to day 21: nothing reaches Grenspoort Cross-dock (3PL), which serves every German customer and holds about a week of their flow.
stories.what_the_plan_did: It filled the cross-dock before the road closed — 18 trucks in the first week, against 15 normally — sent 0 while it was shut, and caught up with 16 in the following three weeks, against 13. Its racking was full at the peak: 190 of 190 pallets, so it could not hold more ahead. Service: 99.43%.

stories.title: A German grocer's promotion order
stories.what_happened: Rheinbogen Frischemarkt, a German grocer delivered through Grenspoort Cross-dock (3PL), places a promotion order for an extra 31k cases of Sparkling Lemonade, due on day 10.
stories.what_the_plan_did: Rheinbogen Frischemarkt were filled at 99.8%. Where capacity ran out, lower-priority accounts went short first: Groothandel Baronie (priority 60) short 2,804 more cases.

takeaways.title: The road into Venlo closes
takeaways.action: It filled the cross-dock before the road closed — 18 trucks in the first week, against 15 normally — sent 0 while it was shut, and caught up with 16 in the following three weeks, against 13.
assumptions: Road closed: day 7 to day 21 of the year.
Found out late: the baseline is kept until day 7, then re-planned as an emergency, the best re-plan possible.
Every plan is proven within ±€128,612 of the best possible; a difference inside that is not a finding.
Prices, costs and the rest of the year's demand are the baseline's.
takeaways.message: Acting ahead saves 20,199 cases from shortage; the money is inside the ±€129k the plans are solved to.
takeaways.case: Found out on day 7, the road into Venlo closes costs €44k of profit and service falls to 99.20%. Acting ahead saves 20,199 cases from shortage; the money is inside the ±€129k the plans are solved to.
calc: Profit a year: baseline €26,992,890; found out on day 7 €26,948,748; acted ahead €27,030,463.
Hit of finding out late = baseline − found out late = €26,992,890 − €26,948,748 = €44,143.
Won back by acting ahead = acted ahead − found out late = €27,030,463 − €26,948,748 = €81,716.
Read against the ±€128,612 the plans are proven to: not a finding, the plans cannot tell it from zero.
Orders served, by value: baseline 99.45%, found out late 99.20%, acted ahead 99.43%.
